title: AIJon: Automated Generation of Annotations for Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2609.18457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern fuzzers use code coverage as feedback to guide their exploration which has proven to be an effective strategy for driving exploration. However, this strategy overlooks inputs that may be interesting to the target program even without uncovering new code paths. Fortunately, prior research has shown that annotations generated by human domain experts can provide additional feedback, guiding the fuzzer towards interesting parts of the program.   In this paper, we replicate experiments presented in IJON and extend them to real-world vulnerability detection at scale. To mitigate the scalability challenge, imposed by the need for human domain expertise, we propose utilizing LLMs to automatically generate annotations. We demonstrate the applicability of LLMs for this purpose and observe that LLMs can generate annotations that perform comparably to human-generated annotations. translated_title: AIJon：面向模糊测试的注解自动生成
translated_abstract: 现代模糊测试器使用代码覆盖率作为反馈来引导其探索，这已被证明是驱动探索的有效策略。然而，这种策略会忽略那些即使未发现新代码路径、但对目标程序而言可能是有价值的输入。幸运的是，先前的研究表明，由人类领域专家生成的注解可以提供额外的反馈，引导模糊测试器关注程序中有趣的部分。在本文中，我们复现了IJON中提出的实验，并将其扩展到大规模的真实世界漏洞检测。为了缓解对人类领域专业知识的依赖所带来的可扩展性挑战，我们提出利用大语言模型（LLMs）自动生成注解。我们证明了LLMs在此用途上的适用性，并观察到LLM生成的注解在性能上可与人类专家生成的注解相媲美。受这一发现的启发，我们设计了AIJON，一个能够（利用LLM自动生成注解以辅助模糊测试的系统）……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型自动生成模糊测试注解，替代依赖人类专家的手工方式，其效果与人工注解相当，从而实现了可扩展的大规模真实世界漏洞检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AIJON, which leverages LLMs to automatically generate fuzzing annotations that perform comparably to human expert annotations, enabling scalable real-world vulnerability detection.
